steps.app: Mendwell (Infra clock and event, then GUI Refresh)
steps.action: Infra moves the clock to 12:41, past the review of Sam's sertraline fill f-20, and applies plan.decided approving pr-12 (Alex's metformin f-16); press Refresh and open f-20
steps.expected: Local commit in Mendwell: f-20's claim is rejected as too soon and f-16 becomes ready; claim-rejected, plan-decision and fill-ready entries join Mendwell's notice log; nothing is sent

steps.action: Infra applies renewal.replied approving rn-2 (Alex's levothyroxine renewal, new rx-20), fill.hold_placed on f-16, fill.collection_attempted on f-16 by Alex while it is held, and fill.hold_released; press Refresh and open f-16
steps.expected: Renewal-reply, held, refused (on hold) and released entries are written locally; f-16 is ready again

steps.action: Open Sam's prepaid omeprazole fill f-17, press Cancel fill, then Confirm cancellation
steps.expected: f-17 cancelled, its $65.00 prepayment voided; payment-voided entries for Sam (patient) and Alex (card owner) are written locally

steps.app: Mendwell (Infra clock and event, then GUI Refresh)
steps.action: Infra moves the clock to Saturday 28 November 13:00, past f-16's pickup reminder (25 November 12:41) and return (28 November 12:41), and applies store.restocked at store st-2, which commits the due timers; press Refresh and open f-16
steps.expected: f-16 returned to stock; return-warning and returned entries are written locally; Mendwell's log now holds all ten notice kinds; Mail is still empty

steps.app: Messaging and Mail (Infra runs the sender; Mail GUI)
steps.action: Infra runs infra/sender.cjs: one Router session per recipient Mail account (mail-p-1 for Sam, mail-p-2 for Alex), each with its grant from infra/router.config.example.json; the sender aligns the Mail clocks and publishes every pending entry; open Mail's page for mail-p-2 in the same run
steps.expected: Receiver commit: one committed Router receipt and one inbox record per entry in the recipient's own account, all ten notice kinds; Mendwell unchanged by publishing

steps.action: Open the “Payment voided” message in Mail; read it through Mail's Agent tool mail.get
steps.expected: The notice text as Mendwell wrote it, from the Mendwell sender address to mail-p-2

observed.subject: Payment voided
observed.body: A prepayment of $65.00 on your card ending 4417 was voided.

steps.action: Open the “Fill returned to stock” message in Mail; read it through Mail's Agent tool mail.get
steps.expected: The notice text as Mendwell wrote it, from the Mendwell sender address to mail-p-2

observed.subject: Fill returned to stock
observed.body: Fill f-16 of metformin hydrochloride 500 mg for Alex Rivera was returned to stock at Mendwell Maple Avenue on Saturday, November 28 at 12:41. The plan claim was reversed. Fills remaining on the prescription are unchanged.

stages.business_confirmation: Not claimed. A committed Mail record shows delivery into the recipient's Mail account, not that the person read or acted on it.

refusal.condition: The Router session for mail-p-1 is configured without the grant for that account (allowed_recipients empty); mail-p-2 keeps its grant
refusal.action: Infra applies fill.hold_placed on Sam's fill f-20, which writes a held entry for Sam (p-1) and for Alex (p-2); Infra aligns the Mail clocks to Mendwell's (adapter.align), records both Apps' state, and runs the sender once
